metadata.description: Felipe Drummond's collection of Claude Code plugins and skills.

plugins.name: linear-planning
plugins.description: Lightweight, prose-first Linear skills: author agent-ready tickets, plan ML research projects as gated milestone arcs from day 0 to publication, implement tickets to a verified PR with handoff written back to Linear, and explain agent-written PRs to cut noise and over-engineering.

plugins.name: studium
plugins.description: A one-to-one tutor for STEM coursework that tests before it teaches. It keeps its own evidence log in a private folder outside your Obsidian vault, writes only an understanding flag to your notes, and schedules surprise retests, so nothing counts as understood until you pass again days later.
